note: Curated model recommendations for the XSLOPE Studio assistant. Published as a release asset beside latest.json and read at most once a day, so the advice can be corrected between app releases. It only MARKS and ORDERS what the dialog lists - nothing here hides a model, and any model id can still be typed into the dialog by hand. 'recommended' is what a fresh install selects; 'good_choices' sort to the top with the labels below; 'deprecated' ids stay selectable and are marked as superseded. Only models that can read an image are offered, since the assistant is regularly shown a sketch or a photograph of a cross section - so every id named here is a vision model. Ollama is deliberately absent: its list is whatever the user has pulled locally.

good_choices.label: flagship
good_choices.note: Strongest on multi-step edits and long autonomous runs. Prompt caching keeps the large xslope system prompt cheap on repeat turns.
